title: Miroslav Kukliš
body: Miroslav Kukliš — 10 September 2002 — The 31-year-old Czech tourist committed suicide by stabbing his chest with a knife during a cave diving trip in the Poganica bay near Split, Croatia. Due to the nature of his death, police initially believed that he was murdered. Later investigation concluded that after Kukliš became lost in the underwater cave and ran out of oxygen, he stabbed himself to avoid the prolonged pain of death by drowning.
